Back-transform ILR coordinates to a composition

Source: R/utils_composition.R
ilr_backtransform.Rd

Inverts ilr_transform(): converts D - 1 pivot ILR coordinates back to the D-part composition, closed to total.

Usage

ilr_backtransform(coords, parts, total = 1, pivot = 1)

Arguments

coords

A data frame or matrix of ILR coordinates with D - 1 columns, in the column order produced by ilr_transform().

parts

Character vector of the D composition part names, in the same order passed to ilr_transform().

total

Row total the composition is closed to (e.g., 1440). Defaults to 1, returning proportions.

pivot

The pivot used in ilr_transform() (name or position).

Value

A tibble with one column per part, rows summing to total.

References

Filzmoser, P., Hron, K., & Templ, M. (2018). Applied Compositional Data Analysis: With Worked Examples in R. Springer. doi:10.1007/978-3-319-96422-5

See also

Other composition helpers: check_composition(), geom_mean_comp(), ilr_transform(), variation_matrix()

Examples

ilr <- ilr_transform(timeuse, c("MVPA", "LPA", "SB", "SPT"), total = 1440)
comp <- ilr_backtransform(
  ilr[c("ilr1", "ilr2", "ilr3")],
  parts = c("MVPA", "LPA", "SB", "SPT"),
  total = 1440
)
all.equal(comp$MVPA, timeuse$MVPA)
#> [1] TRUE
